fy_label_note: Baba/Visible Alpha FY-YYYY = BWXT calendar year (FY-2025 EBITDA $574.3M on $3,198M revenue). Window FY2021 to FY2026E; FY2026 is consensus with Q1 actual. Company targets use adjusted EBITDA margin (17.5% for 2026 per Investor Day), close to VA's 17.46%. Peers: CW, HII, GD, DRS, MIR calendar years; Moog (MOGA) fiscal year ends late September. FY2021 has no Mirion (MIR) data in Baba, so the ratio uses the 5 peers present in both years; the 6-peer FY2026E median is 14.32%.

base_vs_acquired.read: The base defense business (Government Operations, naval propulsion and special materials) held its margin at about 20% to 21%. The consolidated decline is mix: Commercial Operations grew fastest (FY2026 segment revenue growth guided about 45%, slightly more than half of the raise from PCG) at a 12% to 14% margin, diluted further by Kinectrics and PCG capacity investment, plus higher corporate expense. Segment EBITDA dollars by year were not pulled, so the split is directional, not a quantified bridge. The medical business being sold carries a margin 'modestly accretive to the Commercial segment average' (doc 115268), so its exit does not lift the commercial margin.

peers.notes: Defense and nuclear component peers from the Baba Aerospace & Defense comps (US, 53 names) plus Mirion (nuclear measurement, Baba industry Health Care Technology). Negative median decline means the peer median rose. No pure naval-nuclear comparator exists; CW (naval nuclear pumps and valves) is closest and also rose.

prior_dated_targets.target: FY2026 adjusted EBITDA guide, raised to $650M to $665M (Q1) and $662M to $672M (Q2)
FY2026 Commercial Operations adjusted EBITDA margin about 14%

track_record.notes: 10-K ICFR language FY2022 to FY2025 shows effective controls (FY2025 audit excluded Kinectrics as a new acquisition); no restatement or material weakness found. No share-loss admission; this is a sole-source naval nuclear supplier.

tenure.ceo: Rex D. Geveden (President and CEO since January 2017; COO from October 2015; not founder)

deciding_facts: No downturn to attribute: the 5-peer median rose 205 bps (11.49% to 13.55%) while BWXT fell 260 bps (20.07% to 17.46%) on revenue up 80%, so the ratio is -0.79 and the premium to peers halved from +857 to +392 bps.

The compression is self-chosen mix, not operating failure: Government Operations held about 20% to 21% while lower-margin Commercial Operations (Kinectrics, PCG, capacity investment) grew fastest, and management cut the 2026 commercial margin guide to about 13% for investment.
confidence_note: High confidence that the decline is not macro or cycle. 'Execution' here means deliberate acquisition and investment mix, not poor operations; the base defense margin is intact. The long-tenure condition (a) passes, condition (b) fails.
